title: VILLA'S PERFECT EUROPEAN RECORD MEETS CAMP NOU. 3-0.
description:
Yamal scored in the 7th minute. Villa's defence was still putting its boots on.

Villa arrived on a three-game winning run. Barcelona won 3-0. Raphinha added two more, one deflected, one a simple tap-in. Easy work.

Unai Emery said his side lacked a clinical edge. Polite for: we missed, they did not.

Yamal is now the competition's top teenage scorer, with Kylian Mbappe second. Do not tell him. Raphinha has 19 goals in 13 games this season, and defenders across Europe are checking holiday flights.
